events.title: Selected for the SIX Expo!
events.summary: SIX 2023 We are very thrilled to share that we’ve been selected for the 2023 lineup of the Seattle Indies Expo! This weekend, we’ll be exhibiting The BridgeMaster at the Motif in Seattle for this free event on Sunday, September 3rd, from noon to 9pm. It’s just a short walk from the Seattle Convention Center if you happen to be there for PAX. We’d love to see you there! We’re definitely feeling very grateful to be selected!
